content: I umeqqran n imeɣnajen. Zeg ayt n Quraḥ. Azehhed.
Cek tarḍid x temmurt, a SIDI, tessenqeřbed tameḥbast n Yaɛqub.
Tekksed řmuɛṣiyyet x řgens nnec, tedřid marra ddnub nnes. Silah.
Cek tmenɛed marra afugem, tesstewwjed řḥaduq n weɣḍab nnec.
Arr aneɣ, a AREBBI n usenjem nneɣ, ttu aɣḍab nnec xaneɣ.
Ma texsed ad xaneɣ tesɛared i řebda? Ma ad tegged aɣḍab nnec ad iqqim zi jjiř ař jjiř?
Ma war d aneɣ tejjid ad neddar ɛawed, ḥima ad ac ifarḥ řgens nnec?
Scen aneɣ-dd tamexsiwt nnec icewwaren, a SIDI, ewc aneɣ asenjem nnec.
Necc xseɣ ad sřeɣ min ɣa issiweř Arebbi, SIDI, maɣar Netta ad issiweř ak-d řgens nnes u ak-d imtiqqan nnes x řehna. Ɣarwem, mařa nitni ad dd-dewřen ttcařan x yixef nsen.
Nican, aqa yudes-dd usenjem nnes i yinni zzayes itteggʷeden, ḥima aɛuǧi nnes ad izdeɣ di temmurt nneɣ.
Tamexsiwt icewwaren d řaman ad mmsagaren, tasegda d řehna ad mmsudumen.
Tidett ad teɣmi zi temmurt, tasegda ad tessijj ɣar swadday zeg ujenna.
SIDI ad iwc uřa d min iṣebḥen, tammurt nneɣ ad tewc řɣiǧet nnes.
Tasegda ad as tizwar zzat i wudem nnes, ad teḥḍa jjurret n iṣuraf nnes.
